acceptanceCriteria: The nested-module frontier is closed when no nested go.mod requires or replaces the root module path, with the evidence (the nested go.mod paths read) reported.
A fixture whose nested module requires or replaces the root module keeps the frontier open.
An unreadable or unparsable nested go.mod keeps the frontier open as uncertainty.
Spec requirements and maintained tests cover all three cases.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Source: read-only rc.3 accuracy survey 2026-10-06 (origin/main 3dc863bd, installed rc.2 build 360) replaying merged PRs 571, 614, 594, 557, 610 at their merge-base. Harness and outputs: /private/tmp/claude-501/td-survey (local, not retained in the repository). Every go-only plan in the replay reported scope UNKNOWN, and the only unknowns were build-constraint-variants and go:nested-module-frontier. None of the three nested modules (interop/cem01-go, benchmarks/snapshot-reader, conformance/interactive-alpha/fixture) requires or replaces the root module path (read from their go.mod files), so a root-only change cannot affect them through Go imports.
